title: The lid doesn’t stay on during proofing
text: The lid doesn’t stay on during proofing. It’s okay, the lid doesn’t stay on it pops off while in the middle of proofing dough! Therefore allowing temperature to drop and dough doesn’t rise to full capacity it should’ve been 1 star but it wouldn’t let me change it! Don’t waste your money

product_metadata.title: Tescoma Dough-rising bowl with warmer, ø 26 cm, Sourdough Bread Making Tools Kit
features: Excellent for preparing yeast dough very quickly – when shaken in the closed bowl, the content becomes perfectly mixed and rises up to two times faster thanks to the airtight lid and gel warmer.
You do not need to check the rising time – the lid on the bowl becomes visibly bulged when the dough has risen completely.
Do not wash the lid and the gel warmer in dishwasher. Instructions for use with recipe enclosed inside.
The bowl and the stand are dishwasher safe.
description: Dough-rising bowl with warmer Ø 26 cm delícia
